You're laying in bed, tired after a long day of work.  You roll over onto your stomach and let your hand hang off the side of the bed.   You close your eyes and are starting to drift off when you feel something  brush against your hand.  Your heart immediately pounds in your chest, a mix of terror and uncertainty. But the movements of that unknown thing are not threatening. It holds your hand with obvious affection..  As that connection continues, your heart beats more normally and your earlier fear is replaced by curiosity. Slowly, you drag yourself to the edge of the bed and peek down.
